CORE 5 — the model that runs when no API key is set. Classical NLP, fitted in this tab on the wire as it arrives: a Porter stemmer, an n-gram language model with backoff, naive-Bayes routing, TF-IDF and BM25 retrieval, agglomerative topic clustering, TextRank summarisation, rule-based entity recognition, lexicon sentiment, and extractive QA. Zero network, zero weights downloaded.
